nodes.name: CuNi@CF Electrodeposition
nodes.procedure: The CuNi@CF catalyst was deposited by cathodic deposition at a current of 40 mA for 10 min and dried at 60°C for 30 min to be used later. During the deposition process, 5 g of nickel chloride hexahydrate (NiCl₂·6H₂O), 0.2 g of sodium acetate (C₂H₃NaO₂), 0.05 g of copper chloride (CuCl₂·2H₂O) were added to 30 mL of deionized water and stirred at 500 r/min for 30 min to prepare the deposition solution.

nodes.procedure: Disperse a mixture of commercial Pt/C powder (8 mg), carbon black (1.5 mg), and 5 μL of Nafion solution (0.5 wt%) in 1000 μL of ethanol solution. nodes.name: NiFe LDH Hydrothermal Synthesis
nodes.procedure: The Ni foam (2×2 cm²) was first placed in a 2 M hydrochloric acid solution and sonicated for 10 min to remove surface oxides, followed by sonication with anhydrous ethanol and deionized water for 10 min each. One piece of cleaned Ni foam was vertically immersed in a 50 mL Teflon-lined stainless-steel autoclave filled with 30 mL mixed solution containing 0.9 mmol Ni(NO₃)₂·6H₂O, 0.3 mmol Fe(NO₃)₃·9H₂O, and 4 mmol NH₄F. The autoclave was heated to 120°C for 10 h and naturally cooled to room temperature. After the one-step hydrothermal method, the NiFe LDH supported on Ni foam was finally obtained by washing with deionized water several times and drying at 60°C.
